notes: Sepolia Arms v1: MockToken premints 1,000,000 ARMT to the launch owner and permits only holder self-burns; it has no post-launch mint or burnFrom. IMDCourt takes the launch owner for oracle configuration migration, authenticates callbacks against each request intake, verifies the current signer and pins one-based form questions. Arms remains ownerless and creates ArmsForms and ArmsResults internally; local-chain questions must be at least five blocks deep. Other-chain heads still require operator verification. The immutable README fees, caps and windows are preserved. Intake, imdTEST, live attester, 0.5 imdTEST sale and 1,000,000-gas callback limit were checked through public docs/API and Sepolia reads; recheck at launch. No deployment, registration, paid oracle ruling or source verification for this release has occurred in the worker task.
